verdict.rationale: Some SKILL.md descriptions are written as activation triggers: tdd says "Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions 'red-green-refactor'…" and grilling says "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking". But the product's own docs frame usage as manual ("Install the ones you want, then type a slash command", /grill-with-docs), and it even ships a skill for finding which skill to use. The runtime probe only confirmed the installed frontmatter name reads back, not that skills activate on their own. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence that skills auto-activate correctly from task context, trigger-style descriptions documented across all skills, any documented description-engineering methodology, independent corroboration of activation accuracy.
